title: Generosity
competency: Explain generosity and its importance, and be generous to others.

keywords.def: Giving time, effort and resources for the benefit of others.

en.text: Generosity is giving time, effort and resources for the benefit of others; it is an act of selflessness. It makes us feel good, boosts confidence, strengthens relationships and builds a sense of community.

am.text: ለጋስነት ጊዜን፣ ጉልበትንና ሀብትን ለሌሎች ጥቅም ማዋል ነው።

screens.title: Sharing lunch
screens.ask: Sharing your lunch with a classmate who has none. How does it make you feel, according to the book?
opts: Good, because you made someone happy
screens.after: Being generous makes people feel good because they know they made someone happy.

screens.title: Generosity
paras: Generosity is a moral disposition to spend time, effort and resources for others.
The virtuous citizen is generous to others and the community.
It is being kind and willing to give others valuable things: selflessness.

screens.title: Why it matters
paras: Good deeds with good intentions bring positive outcomes.
Generosity boosts confidence and keeps away self-hatred.
It strengthens relationships and builds a sense of community.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Giving time, effort and resources for the benefit of others.

screens.text: Which are ways to be generous?
pool: Giving time to help a classmate study
a: Giving time to help a classmate study
screens.why: Generosity is time, effort or resources for others.

screens.ask: ___ is the disposition to spend time, effort and resources for the benefit of others

screens.text: How does generosity help the community?
opts: It builds a sense of community and connection
screens.ans: It builds a sense of community and connection

screens.text: Which shows generosity with TIME rather than money?
opts: Helping an old neighbour carry water every Saturday
screens.ans: Helping an old neighbour carry water every Saturday
screens.why: Generosity includes time and effort, not only resources.
